title: ddc-web-editor/1 — browser editor bundle
description: Published next to the browser build of the editor. The ERP reads it to know what to download in the background (files, sizes, hashes) and how to start it: entry *.js = ES module exporting mount(element, host) (README section 11), entry *.html = page for a sandboxed iframe speaking postMessage.

load.description: start (default): the ERP downloads it in the background before the first open. on_demand: the page fetches it from the bundle folder when needed (locale catalogs, script fonts) and checks bytes and SHA-256 against this manifest; the ERP serves it but does not prefetch it.
